subject.title: fix(reef): bound JSONL store file reads to prevent OOM on oversized audit/replay stores

question: Should Reef ship a 32 MiB fail-closed replay-ledger limit without a built-in receipt-preserving recovery path, or should the owner provide an explicit supported recovery contract first?
rationale: The patch deliberately trades availability for replay-receipt safety; source-level mechanics cannot determine the acceptable operator and retention policy for production deployments.

options.title: Require supported recovery before merge
options.body: Add a Reef-owned, receipt-preserving recovery or documented rotation procedure with focused upgrade proof before accepting the new hard failure mode.

options.title: Accept the strict fail-closed contract
options.body: Merge the limit as an intentional security boundary and explicitly document the operator retention, backup, and manual recovery requirements.

recommendation.title: Require supported recovery before merge
recommendation.body: Add a Reef-owned, receipt-preserving recovery or documented rotation procedure with focused upgrade proof before accepting the new hard failure mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR history shows direct ownership of the proposed replay-ledger behavior, although a Reef-area owner should make the final policy decision.
